projects.title: Calculus: derivatives and integrals
projects.blurb: The rules of differentiation, the chain rule and tangent lines; then antiderivatives the engine checks by differentiating, definite integrals and Riemann sums.

lessons.title: The rules of differentiation
lessons.blurb: Powers, sums, constant multiples and products: four rules, every step named.

lessons.title: The chain rule
lessons.blurb: Functions of functions: the outer derivative times the inner one, with a slider to watch the inner factor.

lessons.title: Higher derivatives and tangent lines
lessons.blurb: Derivatives of derivatives, slopes at a point, and the tangent line that follows a slider.

lessons.title: Antiderivatives, checked
lessons.blurb: Integration as the search for a function whose derivative you know, accepted only after the engine differentiates it back.

lessons.title: Definite integrals and sums
lessons.blurb: The fundamental theorem of calculus, finite sums, and Riemann sums that close in on the area as a slider adds rectangles.

projects.title: Linear algebra: vectors, matrices and systems
projects.blurb: Vectors and the dot product, matrix arithmetic, solving systems by row reduction with verified row operations, and determinants.

lessons.title: Vectors and the dot product
lessons.blurb: Adding and scaling vectors, lengths, and the dot product that measures angles.

lessons.title: Matrices
lessons.blurb: Matrix arithmetic, the product that is not commutative, the transpose, and a matrix acting on a vector.

lessons.title: Solving systems by row reduction
lessons.blurb: An augmented matrix, the three row operations (each proved to keep the solutions), and reading the answer off the reduced form.

lessons.title: Determinants
lessons.blurb: The determinant of 2×2 and 3×3 matrices, the product rule, and what a zero determinant means.

projects.title: λ-calculus: computing by reduction
projects.blurb: Terms, β-reduction in normal order and why substitution must avoid capture; then numbers, arithmetic and booleans built from functions alone.

lessons.title: β-reduction
lessons.blurb: Applying a function by substituting its argument, one redex at a time, and the renaming that keeps substitution honest.

lessons.title: Church numerals and booleans
lessons.blurb: Numbers as repeated application, arithmetic as composition, and booleans as choice.

projects.title: Explorations
projects.blurb: Notebooks that show what ChalkMath does: a tour, Fourier series drawing a llama, and order theory with its proofs in Lean.

lessons.title: Welcome to ChalkMath
lessons.blurb: A short tour: running cells, reading the steps, and one example from each area.

lessons.title: Drawing llamas with circles
lessons.blurb: Fourier series from inner products to epicycles, ending with a llama drawn by spinning circles.

lessons.title: Order and lattices
lessons.blurb: Part I of From Zero to Propagators: partial orders, joins and meets, monotone maps and fixed points, with the proofs in Lean cells.
